biggest_gap.title: Printed documents stop at 2,000 rows: a long list or report cannot be printed or saved as a PDF whole
biggest_gap.detail: The form now edits in fewer actions than Odoo, and every compared print task wins. What most limits the piece for a UAE trading or manufacturing company is what it can put on paper. Every PDF, on-screen document and print (ReportEngine.DocumentRowLimit = 2000) stops at the first 2,000 rows. It says so ('The first 2,000 of 100,007 rows; narrow the parameters to print the rest'), but it gives no way to print the rest. Only CSV/XLSX carry up to 200,000 rows. A stock list, price list, customer statement, or an aged list for an auditor or a free-zone authority routinely runs past 2,000 lines, and it is wanted as one signed PDF in English or Arabic, not as an XLSX or a set of narrowed prints. Every later module (sales, purchasing, inventory, accounting) inherits this cap through the report framework. Needed: a PDF/print path that renders the whole selection, for example streamed or paged rendering, or a background job for large documents. The run must stay read-only and tenant-scoped, and the document must say how many rows it holds.

The phone field takes a code typed again but accepts malformed UAE numbers silently. Typing 9715055501 (two digits short of the 12-key entry) shows '+971 9 715 055501' and Enter saves it. 97150555019 saves '+971 9 715 0555019' (11 national digits), and 971971234567 saves '+971 9 712 34567'. The server accepts all of them (browser/explore-form.log 'edge' lines; api/db-audit-phone.txt). The real Fujairah line 97123456 is kept correctly (+971 9 712 3456, saved only by Enter), as designed. A typo in the 12-key path thus becomes a stored, wrongly grouped 'Fujairah' number. A length check on +971 numbers (server error on the field) would stop it.
